name: employee.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Person (mk-Person (age Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Employee (mk-Employee (age Int)(boss Ref)(officemate Ref)(car Ref)))))
(declare-sort Car) (declare-const mk-Car Car)

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Person (sel-Person Person))
  (lift-Employee (sel-Employee Employee))
  (lift-Car (sel-Car Car))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Person ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Person (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Person ((this Ref)) Person
  (sel-Person (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Employee ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Employee (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Employee ((this Ref)) Employee
  (sel-Employee (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Car ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Car (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Car ((this Ref)) Car
  (sel-Car (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Person ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Person this)
    (deref-is-Employee this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Employee ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Employee this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Car ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Car this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Person:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Person.age: ---

(define-fun Person.age ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-Person this) (age (deref-Person this))
  (age (deref-Employee this)))
)

(define-fun Person!age ((this Ref)) Int
  (age (deref-Person this))
)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class Employee:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for Employee.age: ---

(define-fun Employee.age ((this Ref)) Int
  (age (deref-Employee this))
)

(define-fun Employee!age ((this Ref)) Int
  (age (deref-Employee this))
)

; --- getters for Employee.boss: ---

(define-fun Employee!boss ((this Ref)) Ref
  (boss (deref-Employee this))
)

; --- getters for Employee.officemate: ---

(define-fun Employee.officemate ((this Ref)) Ref
  (officemate (deref-Employee this))
)

(define-fun Employee!officemate ((this Ref)) Ref
  (officemate (deref-Employee this))
)

; --- getters for Employee.car: ---

(define-fun Employee!car ((this Ref)) Ref
  (car (deref-Employee this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -----------------------------
;   Methods for class Person:
; -----------------------------

(define-fun Person.getAge ((this Ref)) Int
  (Person.age this)
)

(define-fun Person!getAge ((this Ref)) Int
  (Person!age this)
)

; -------------------------------
;   Methods for class Employee:
; -------------------------------

(define-fun Employee.getAge ((this Ref)) Int
  (Employee.age this)
)

(define-fun Employee!getAge ((this Ref)) Int
  (Employee!age this)
)

(define-fun Employee.avoid ((this Ref)(p Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (Employee.officemate this) p))
)

(define-fun Employee!avoid ((this Ref)(p Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (Employee!officemate this) p))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Person:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Person Person)
(declare-const const-2-Person Person)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Person.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Person!getAge this ) 18)
)

(assert (! (Person.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))
(assert (! (Person.inv1 2) :named _xkassert1))



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Employee:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Employee Employee)
(declare-const const-4-Employee Employee)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Employee.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Person (Employee!boss this))
)

(assert (! (Employee.inv1 3) :named _xkassert2))
(assert (! (Employee.inv1 4) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Employee.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Employee (Employee!officemate this))
)

(assert (! (Employee.inv2 3) :named _xkassert4))
(assert (! (Employee.inv2 4) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Employee.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Car (Employee!car this))
)

(assert (! (Employee.inv3 3) :named _xkassert6))
(assert (! (Employee.inv3 4) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Employee.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Employee!getAge this ) 18)
)

(assert (! (Employee.inv4 3) :named _xkassert8))
(assert (! (Employee.inv4 4) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun Employee.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (Person.age (Employee!boss this)) 30)
)

(assert (! (Employee.inv5 3) :named _xkassert10))
(assert (! (Employee.inv5 4) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun Employee.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= this (Employee.officemate (Employee!officemate this)))
)

(assert (! (Employee.inv6 3) :named _xkassert12))
(assert (! (Employee.inv6 4) :named _xkassert13))



; ----------------------------
;   Invariant for class Car:
; ----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-Car Car)
(declare-const const-6-Car Car)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-Person const-1-Person))
        2 (lift-Person const-2-Person))
        3 (lift-Employee const-3-Employee))
        4 (lift-Employee const-4-Employee))
        5 (lift-Car const-5-Car))
        6 (lift-Car const-6-Car))
  )
)
smtModel:
;; universe for Car:
;;   Car!val!1 Car!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun Car!val!1 () Car)
(declare-fun Car!val!0 () Car)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x Car)) (or (= x Car!val!1) (= x Car!val!0)))
;; -----------
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (car (sel-Employee (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-Car a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (officemate (sel-Employee (select heap 3))))))
  (= 3 (officemate (sel-Employee a!1)))))
(define-fun const-5-Car () Car
  Car!val!0)
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (boss (sel-Employee (select heap 3))))))
  (or (is-lift-Person a!1) (is-lift-Employee a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (officemate (sel-Employee (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-Employee a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (officemate (sel-Employee (select heap 4))))))
  (= 4 (officemate (sel-Employee a!1)))))
(define-fun const-6-Car () Car
  Car!val!1)
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (> (age (sel-Employee (select heap 4))) 18))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (boss (sel-Employee (select heap 4))))))
  (or (is-lift-Person a!1) (is-lift-Employee a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (boss (sel-Employee (select heap 4))))))
  (> (ite (is-lift-Person a!1) (age (sel-Person a!1)) (age (sel-Employee a!1)))
     30)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (> (age (sel-Person (select heap 1))) 18))
(define-fun const-4-Employee () Employee
  (mk-Employee 20849 3 4 6))
(define-fun const-1-Person () Person
  (mk-Person 19))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (> (age (sel-Employee (select heap 3))) 18))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (car (sel-Employee (select heap 3))))))
  (is-lift-Car a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (> (age (sel-Person (select heap 2))) 18))
(define-fun const-2-Person () Person
  (mk-Person 1161))
(define-fun const-3-Employee () Employee
  (mk-Employee 31 4 3 6))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (boss (sel-Employee (select heap 3))))))
  (> (ite (is-lift-Person a!1) (age (sel-Person a!1)) (age (sel-Employee a!1)))
     30)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (officemate (sel-Employee (select heap 3))))))
  (is-lift-Employee a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         1
                         (lift-Person (mk-Person 19)))
                  2
                  (lift-Person (mk-Person 1161)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 3 (lift-Employee (mk-Employee 31 4 3 6)))
                  4
                  (lift-Employee (mk-Employee 20849 3 4 6)))))
  (store (store a!2 5 (lift-Car Car!val!0)) 6 (lift-Car Car!val!1)))))
